name: Victorian excess electricity concession
provider: Victorian Department of Families, Fairness and Housing
summary: 17.5% off the part of your yearly electricity costs above a high threshold, for Victorian Health Care Card holders.
key: 17.5% of electricity usage and service costs above the annual threshold.
who: Electricity account holder in Victoria with annual electricity costs above $4,217.85.
Holds a Health Care Card, Pensioner Concession Card or DVA Gold Card.
how: Your retailer identifies eligible customers and sends a form. Sign it with a witness and return it.
catches: The threshold is reviewed each year. Processing takes up to four weeks.

evidence.quote: An electricity account holder whose annual electricity costs are above $4,217.85
